name: token-weather-usage
description: One line above the prompt: context tokens with their weather, a bar per recent prompt, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, the prompt cache with its time left, the session cost with the last prompt's share in dollars and in points of the 5-hour limit, and the subagents running. Labels in English, French or Russian. After Token Weather (Anthropic, Apache-2.0) and the ideas of usage-meter (HolyGrail) and prompt-cache-control (Daniel San).

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in English (en), French (fr) or Russian (ru), or auto: follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG, and falls back to English.
